rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something broad in range or scope, especially research, knowledge, or interests, rather than a large physical area.

example.english: I have extensive interests in the history of different parts of the world.
example.traditional: 我對世界各地嘅歷史都有廣泛興趣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 sai3 gaai3 gok3 dei6 ge3 lik6 si2 dou1 jau5 gwong2 faan3 hing3 ceoi3

rows.note: Use this for physical area or extent, such as damage, flooding, or a power outage affecting a large area.

example.english: The extensive power outage left many shops without electricity.
example.traditional: 今次大範圍停電，搞到好多舖頭都冇電。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 daai6 faan6 wai4 ting4 din6 gaau2 dou3 hou2 do1 pou3 tau2 dou1 mou5 din6

rows.note: Use this when extensive means a considerable quantity or amount, as in extensive research, data, or work.

example.english: We did extensive research to write this report.
example.traditional: 為咗寫呢份報告，我哋做咗大量研究。
example.jyutping: wai6 zo2 se2 ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ngo5 dei6 zou6 zo2 daai6 loeng6 jin4 gau3
